overview: The Medford City Council established the fiscal year 2027 budget schedule and approved a petition to remove the Police Chief and Deputy positions from civil service law. The Council also expressed support for an updated ordinance regarding the Commission for Persons with Disabilities and addressed several business licensing matters.

items.title: Announcements and Records
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from March 10, 2026.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a report detailing progress on a vacant building ordinance and a cleanup of city zoning codes.

items.title: Update to Commission for Persons with Disabilities Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposal to modernize ordinance language and clarify the commission's role to legal review with an expression of council support. The update removes stigmatizing language and defines the commission's involvement in municipal accessibility planning.

items.title: License Amendment for Ho-Win Palace
items.summary: Approved an extension of operating hours until 1:00 a.m. for Ho-Win Palace, subject to a 30-60-90 day review period.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Process
items.summary: Adopted the schedule for the fiscal year 2027 budget cycle and authorized the Council President to submit collective recommendations to the Mayor regarding school funding, residential exemptions, and department staffing.

items.title: Update on Inclusion Specialist Hiring
items.summary: Referred a request for an update on the hiring of a city inclusion specialist to the Education and Culture Committee.

items.title: Exemption of Police Leadership from Civil Service
items.summary: Approved a petition for special legislation to exempt the positions of Police Chief and Deputy Police Chief from civil service law to allow for a broader candidate search. The change follows a collective bargaining agreement supported by the superior officers' union.

items.title: Food Truck Permit and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved a seasonal food truck permit for Trolley Dogs at Hormel Stadium to serve during Boston Glory home games.
